name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Frost, Music, and Yearbook belong to different classes.
Between Art and Geography, one goes with Dunn and the other with Frost.
Exactly one of these is true: Frost goes with Geography; Frost goes with Drama; Art goes with Choir.
Frost goes with Choir if and only if Dunn does not go with Art.

chain: Start by assuming Ames does not go with Music.
